description.value: A private oceanfront resort on Georgia Strait just north of Courtenay, offering tidal pools, sandbars, and coastal mountain views alongside kayak rentals and a boat launch; tenting sites share the grounds with full-service RV hookups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active RV and tent campground on Vancouver Island near Courtenay. Phone (250-334-4154) and address (5726 Coral Rd, Courtenay, BC V9J 1W9) match between OSM and the website. The site has a booking request form confirming reservations are accepted. The website mentions 'Full service RV hookups, cozy and peaceful tenting sites' but the Resort Amenities subpage content was not included in the fetch, so specific facility amenities (showers, laundry, water, etc.) cannot be confirmed despite likely existing at a full-service RV resort. No hiker/biker-specific sites or cyclist amenities are mentioned.
concerns: Resort Amenities subpage was not included in the website fetch, so facility-level amenities (showers, laundry, water, etc.) could not be verified despite being likely present at a full-service RV resort
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active oceanfront campground with tenting sites on a popular Vancouver Island cycling corridor (Hwy 19A), accessible from the Powell River ferry route. Suitable for touring cyclists despite no cyclist-specific amenities being documented.
